name: Grade 6 T2 Summative: Robotics Vocabulary
description: Ten core second-trimester words for the Grade 6 robotics summative vocabulary table.

words.definition: A machine that can follow instructions to do a task.
words.example: The robot moved across the floor.

words.definition: A small classroom robot used for coding and testing.
words.example: The mBot followed the route on the tape.

words.definition: A set of instructions a computer or robot follows.
words.example: The program told the robot to turn.

words.definition: One step that tells a computer or robot what to do.
words.example: The first instruction made the robot move forward.

words.definition: Acting in a way that protects people and materials.
words.example: Safety rules help us use robots carefully.

words.definition: A part that makes something move.
A round part that helps a robot move.
words.example: The wheel rolled on the floor.

words.definition: A part that detects something around it.
A small light on a device or robot.
words.example: The LED turned red when the program started.

words.definition: A small part that makes a sound.
words.example: The buzzer made a short beep.
